standards.description: When objects interact, forces transfer energy between them; work is that transfer measured as force times distance.
standards.traceDetail: Pushing the cart along the track shows work = force × distance adding kinetic energy.

standards.description: The amount of energy transferred depends on the net force and the distance, and work done on an object increases its kinetic energy.
standards.traceDetail: The cart's gaining energy equals the work counter — energy conservation in a glance.

standards.standard: Reason About and Solve One-Variable Equations
standards.description: Understand solving equations as a process of deducing which number makes them true.
standards.traceDetail: Force × distance products and J totals for practice.
